description.text: The last set of the HeartGold & SoulSilver series and of the fourth generation, released on 9 February 2011 as a filler set before the fifth generation, with no Japanese counterpart. Its 106 cards are 95 numbered, mostly reprints of HeartGold & SoulSilver cards with the rest of the Japanese Lost Link set and promos, and 11 Shiny Legendaries numbered SL1 to SL11, among them Entei, Raikou and Suicune. It has no Pokémon Prime or LEGEND, and its Lost World Stadium brought in a new way to win: when an opponent has six Pokémon in the Lost Zone.
